    [mild] Lemma 2.2 #

    If ρ = π(y) factors through α, it does not factor through β (MildContour.not_ρ_factor_both). [mild] refers this to the end of the proof of Lemma 2.1, whose argument assumes that ρ factors through neither arrow; we argue instead with the first point where paths for the two factorizations part (a cleaving D̃₄ or D̃₅ in P/τ).

    r.length ≠ 0 → ∃ (c : RayVert P) (e : a ⟶ c) (r' : Quiver.Path c b), r = (Quiver.Path.nil.cons e).comp r'
